name: segment-bar
title: Segment Bar
description: A row of rounded blocks sized by share, over a colour-keyed legend in two columns or as rows with counts. Uses namespace exports: SegmentBar.Root.

docs.lead: Each segment is its own rounded block, sized by its share. Nothing is featured by default; hovering a block prints its value inside it and gives its legend entry a pill. Zero and small segments retain an 8px minimum width.
docs.usage:
import * as SegmentBar from "@/components/ui/segment-bar"

<SegmentBar.Root
  items={[{ label: "Category A", value: 13 }]}
/>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A label-only legend split into two columns. Nothing is featured until a block is hovered. A block too narrow for its number opens far enough to fit it.

examples.title: Rows legend
examples.description: A full-width legend with each actual count on the right. Nothing is featured until a block is hovered, when that block and its legend entry are featured.

api.name: SegmentBar.Root
api.description: The blocks and their legend. Colours follow item order through the five-step chart ramp.

props.name: items
props.description: Segments left to right, in the order given

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Label of the segment to feature. Omitted or null features none. A hovered segment is featured as well

props.name: legend
props.description: Two label-only columns, or rows with counts
